name: M3_MWS410MI_GetHead
description: Retrieve detailed header information for a single delivery. The call returns the same header data that you see for a delivery in the Delivery. Open Toolbox (MWS410) function, including references, routing, dates, statuses, packaging and value‑related settings. Exactly one delivery header is returned per successful call. The interface is typically invoked once per delivery number and is normally used with medium call frequency in integrations, for example from MEC maps that need delivery context before processing lines, packages or documents.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company for which the delivery head information is retrieved.

inputParameters.name: DLIX
inputParameters.description: Delivery number identifying the delivery whose head information is retrieved.

inputParameters.name: CONA
inputParameters.description: Consignee ID used as an additional selection criterion when retrieving the delivery head.

inputParameters.name: PUTP
inputParameters.description: Qualifier specifying the type of delivery note reference used to select the delivery.

inputParameters.name: PUSN
inputParameters.description: Delivery note reference used to select the delivery when an external pickup or delivery note is supplied.

outputParameters.name: DLIX
outputParameters.description: Delivery number.

outputParameters.name: DONR
outputParameters.description: Standard document number used for the main delivery document, such as the delivery note.

outputParameters.name: DOVA
outputParameters.description: Variant code of the main delivery document connected to the delivery.

outputParameters.name: CONN
outputParameters.description: Shipment number to which the delivery is connected, if any.

outputParameters.name: FDNO
outputParameters.description: Freight or delivery document number associated with the delivery.

outputParameters.name: IVNO
outputParameters.description: Invoice number linked to this delivery, if it has been invoiced.

outputParameters.name: IVDT
outputParameters.description: Invoice date for the invoice linked to this delivery.

outputParameters.name: DONO
outputParameters.description: Internal identity of the document connected to this delivery.

outputParameters.name: GEDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the delivery record was created in the system.

outputParameters.name: ELDT
outputParameters.description: Date when electronic notification about the delivery is scheduled to be sent.

outputParameters.name: ELTM
outputParameters.description: Time when electronic notification about the delivery is scheduled to be sent.

outputParameters.name: SHD4
outputParameters.description: Actual ship date when the delivery was issued from stock.

outputParameters.name: SHTM
outputParameters.description: Actual ship time when the delivery was issued from stock.

outputParameters.name: CUOR
outputParameters.description: Customer’s own order reference associated with this delivery.

outputParameters.name: PUSN
outputParameters.description: Delivery note reference received from the customer or scheduling process for this delivery.

outputParameters.name: PUTP
outputParameters.description: Qualifier specifying the type of delivery note reference used for this delivery.

outputParameters.name: E0B4
outputParameters.description: Transport identity, such as a truck ID, used for the departure of this delivery.

outputParameters.name: E0BH
outputParameters.description: Registration number of the trailer used to transport the delivery.

outputParameters.name: TRCA
outputParameters.description: Code identifying the transportation equipment used for this delivery.

outputParameters.name: E0BI
outputParameters.description: Deliver‑via location through which the delivery is routed before reaching the final destination.

outputParameters.name: ROUT
outputParameters.description: Transportation route assigned to the delivery.

outputParameters.name: CUSU
outputParameters.description: Supplier number that the customer uses to identify your company for this delivery.

outputParameters.name: VRNO
outputParameters.description: VAT registration number used for invoicing this delivery.

outputParameters.name: VRN2
outputParameters.description: Secondary VAT registration number related to this delivery, when applicable.

outputParameters.name: YREF
outputParameters.description: Customer contact person or reference name for this delivery.

outputParameters.name: MODL
outputParameters.description: Delivery method used for transporting the goods, such as road or air.

outputParameters.name: TEDL
outputParameters.description: Delivery terms (for example Incoterms) that define when responsibility for the goods passes from you to the customer.

outputParameters.name: NRUL
outputParameters.description: Total number of packages on the delivery.

outputParameters.name: GRW2
outputParameters.description: Actual gross weight of all packed goods for the delivery.

outputParameters.name: NEW2
outputParameters.description: Actual net weight of all packed goods for the delivery.

outputParameters.name: PAV3
outputParameters.description: Packed volume of goods for the delivery.

outputParameters.name: RORC
outputParameters.description: Order category indicating the origin type of the delivery's reference order, for example customer or distribution order.

outputParameters.name: WHLO

outputParameters.name: RIDN
outputParameters.description: Reference order number from which the delivery was created.

outputParameters.name: RODN
outputParameters.description: Route departure code representing the specific departure used for this delivery.

outputParameters.name: SDES
outputParameters.description: ID of the loading place where goods are loaded for this delivery.

outputParameters.name: EDES
outputParameters.description: ID of the unloading place or geographic location for the delivery destination.

outputParameters.name: HAFE

outputParameters.name: TRDT
outputParameters.description: Transaction date associated with this delivery record.

outputParameters.name: TRTM

outputParameters.name: BLOP

outputParameters.name: RLFA

outputParameters.name: RLTD

outputParameters.name: PGRS
outputParameters.description: Overall delivery status indicating the processing stage in the outbound or inbound flow.

outputParameters.name: PIST

outputParameters.name: PCKA
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether packaging actions are to be performed for the delivery.

outputParameters.name: PLSX
outputParameters.description: Suffix identifying a specific picking list created for this delivery.

outputParameters.name: TIZO

outputParameters.name: ADVI
outputParameters.description: Via address through which the transport is shipped before arriving at the final address.

outputParameters.name: DTDT
outputParameters.description: Requested departure date for the delivery as retrieved from the order or dispatch policy.

outputParameters.name: DTHM
outputParameters.description: Requested departure time for the delivery on the requested departure date.

outputParameters.name: TSIN

outputParameters.name: DOCR

outputParameters.name: DOCE

outputParameters.name: SHLV

outputParameters.name: AUCO

outputParameters.name: RCDT

outputParameters.name: RCTM

outputParameters.name: DEWD

outputParameters.name: SEEQ

outputParameters.name: IVSS

outputParameters.name: PRIO

outputParameters.name: CUCL

outputParameters.name: CSCD

outputParameters.name: ECAR

outputParameters.name: PONO

outputParameters.name: OLIX

outputParameters.name: SULS

outputParameters.name: LODO

outputParameters.name: ETRN

outputParameters.name: FWNO

outputParameters.name: PALR

outputParameters.name: GANS

outputParameters.name: TEDF
outputParameters.description: Final delivery terms applied to the delivery after any changes during processing.

outputParameters.name: NBOL
outputParameters.description: Bill of lading number identifying the shipment for this delivery.

outputParameters.name: MBOL

outputParameters.name: FDAL

outputParameters.name: INPX

outputParameters.name: EXIN

outputParameters.name: CONA
outputParameters.description: Consignee ID for the delivery destination.

outputParameters.name: SEAL

outputParameters.name: DSDT

outputParameters.name: DSHM

outputParameters.name: FRCO

outputParameters.name: SPLE

outputParameters.name: AGNB

outputParameters.name: DRCD

outputParameters.name: DFHM

outputParameters.name: PWDT

outputParameters.name: PWHM
outputParameters.description: Forwarder’s planned arrival time at the loading or unloading point for this delivery.

outputParameters.name: AWDT
